decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is occupied.

Condition : 3 - The office floorspace contained within the development hereby approved shall be used only as offices ancillary to the main use of the premises as B2 and shall not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 4 - The proposed mezzanine floor indicated on drawing 15/8/ARCH/03/F of planning permission 00229/Q/P9 shall be used as storage space ancillary to the main use of the premises as B2 and shall not be used for any other purpose, and upon cessation of the use of the premises as an in-flight catering facility it shall be removed.
Condition : 5 - No additional floorspace shall be formed within the buildings hereby permitted by means of internal horizontal division without prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - No industrial or storage activity shall be carried oo outside the buildings hereby permitted except for loading and unloading without the prior written of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 7 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Variation of condition 4 to replace the reference from ' by Strikepart ltd to 'as an in-flight catering facility" of approved planning permission ref: 00229/Q/P9 dated 25/09/1992.
